title: What have you guys seen inside the airport
content: Ok so I'm not sure if this should be here but I want to cross reference with anything you guys have seen specifically in the airport because I have one dream I remember vividly, and usually I don't remember dreams unless I have repeated them but I have only had this one once, but I was in an airport that barely looked like an airport, it was like a airport that had been stripped of everything, It had walls that were all windows, that crappy carpet everywhere, the gross airport chairs lined most of the walls, and it had multiple levels like airports usually do but instead of having stairs, or escalators, or even elevators it just had carpeted ramps. I don't exactly remember what was outside the windows as I was kinda rushing around and didn't pay attention but I was there with a group and we were the only people there and the ramps just kept going up and it was taller than an airport should be. Sorry if it's a bad explanation or if this isn't where I should post this I just wanted to share and ask if you guys have seen the same or similar.
